description_en: Updates the resources. After you call this operation, an asynchronous task is triggered to update your resources and data protection score
description_zh: 更新资源列表。调用该接口后，将会触发一个异步任务来更新您的资源列表和数据保护评分
name: UpdateResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. If left empty, all types are updated. You can specify multiple resource types separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，不填代表更新所有类型。支持使用英文逗号（,）分隔传入多个资源类型
parameters.name: resource_type
